environment.description: Application deployed on a single EC2 instance (t3.medium) running Amazon Linux 2, exposed directly via public Elastic IP on port 8080. Security group allows inbound TCP 8080 from 0.0.0.0/0. No reverse proxy or load balancer in front. Application runs as systemd service under 'appuser' account. SQLite database at /var/lib/app/users.db with production data. Environment variable FLASK_DEBUG=0.
